messages.subject: What is the strategy of Shiny to searches for ui.r?
parts: I am testing the HTML UI, so I rename the file ui.r into ui_rename.r, but the old UI keeps appearing, until I again rename ui_rename.r into ui_old.r. What is the logic here? Thank you.

messages.subject: Re: What is the strategy of Shiny to searches for ui.r?
parts:
(Sorry for the delay, I've been sick for a few days)

When switching between ui.R and www/index.html approaches, you need to restart the app (meaning, just returning to the R top-level and calling runApp again).
